metadata.description: Prowl Claude Code plugin: one MCP that gives any agent 448 market-intelligence tools (SEO, ads, SERP, scraping, AI) on pay-as-you-go USD wallet billing, plus a status widget that makes a running call, its progress and its cost visible in the terminal.

plugins.name: prowl
plugins.description: Adds the namespaced Prowl install/usage skill, the hosted Prowl MCP server, and the status widget: in-flight calls, async-session progress in the dock, session spend from the server's own billing figures, and a one-time notice when a call fails.

plugins.name: prowl-cli
plugins.description: Adds the Prowl CLI skill: drive the same 448-tool catalog from the shell with @prowl-ai/cli — no MCP server required.
